authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: Reviewed whole-form continuation of Dang ɖʌs “ten” (f_pnkl2zze65rtc). Family evidence: CDIAL 6227 daśa gives Palula daš and regional das ten. These survey retroflex/dental and sibilant variants fit the numeral family. Reviewed comparison: Dang dʌs “ten” (f_er756efsusgpm). Possible intra-IA transfer remains open; source forms and provenance are preserved. The present source form was inspected for phonetic and gloss differences; normalization was used only to find it, and its exact spelling is preserved.
